name: ai4kanban-cloud
description: The service every AI4Kanban Cloud workspace runs on — the Worker at api.ai4kanban.dev and its Postgres schema.

scripts.deploy: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy wrangler deploy
scripts.rollback: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy wrangler rollback
scripts.dev: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy wrangler dev
scripts.tail: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u ALL_PROXY -u all_proxy wrangler tail
